slides.title: Our caring action
slides.text:
Do ONE useful class action.
Check what helped. Reflect in your book.
Use our real plan if we have it.
You can point, do a small role or ask an adult to write.

slides.title: Ready to start
slides.text:
Choose: ready, rest or help.
You can point in a quiet way.
Start: I feel __.
Model: I feel ready.
You can pause with an adult.

slides.title: Our one agreed action
slides.text:
Use our real Week 3 class plan if we have it.
If not, agree ONE option now: book tray OR help card.
Ask the adult to check the kit and useful place.
Words: plan, ask, check. Start: We will __.
Model only: We will set up a book tray.
We do the agreed job today.

slides.title: Today’s two source goals
slides.text:
Take part in a class 'caring' action.
Reflect on fairness; evidence skills (the unit award).
Do one agreed action. Then reflect on real work.
Words: care, ask, help, share, role, check.
Start: I helped by __. It was fair because __.
Model only: I helped put books in the tray.

slides.title: Ask and check first
slides.text:
Two options shown. We choose and do ONE.
Ask first. Listen to yes or no. Respect no.
Words: ask, care, check. Start: Can I help with __?
Model: Can I put these shared books in the tray?

slides.title: Share the roles
slides.text:
Choose a small role: choose, place, make, point, read or check.
Use only adult-checked shared kit. You can work seated.
If someone says no, stop and check with the adult.
Words: ask, share, role, check. Start: I can __.
Model: I can check the label.

slides.title: Do our class action
slides.text:
Do the ONE job we agreed.
A Put shared light books in a labelled tray.
OR B Make one class help card and place it.
Share the roles. Ask first. Keep the model in view.
Words: care, help, share, role, check.
Start: I can __. Model: I can point to the label.
An adult can write or move a part you choose.

slides.title: Check and reflect
slides.text:
Can someone use the tray or the help card now?
Show your actual part and what helped.
In your book: keep a short own reflection.
If a part is not done, say We still need __.
Words: care, ask, help, share, role, check.
Start: I helped by __. It was fair because __.
Model only: I helped put books in the tray.

slides.title: My quiet response
slides.text:
Share your actual line in a quiet way.
Listen to one reply and one next step.
Keep or change your words.
Words: care, ask, help, share, role, check.
Start: I helped by __. It was fair because __.
Model only: I helped put books in the tray.

slides.title: Our closing check
slides.text:
Show your actual role or choice.
Keep gaps open if work is missing.
An adult checks the six rows and the real work.
Words: care, ask, help, share, role, check.
Start: I helped by __. It was fair because __.
Model only: I helped put books in the tray.

slides.title: Words that help
slides.text:
care: help and respect choice. ask: check if help is wanted.
share: let each person have a fair part.
role: your part in the task.
check: see if it is safe and useful.
Start: I helped by __. It was fair because __.
Model only: I helped put books in the tray.

slides.title: Adult support brief
slides.text:
Three to four pupils; Pupil number: ____. 10,15,15 minute blocks.
Use actual W03 plan or explicitly agree ONE fallback now.
DO one safe useful action; do not claim it before teaching.
Accessible roles, ask first, accept no; adult-check kit/place.
Keep bank, stem and model. Private choices/exact scribe.
Evidence Sheet pages3–4: six-outcome tick/comment grid/checklist.
R: Voice + audience reply + one NS + own response.
E: actual banking. Staff check the unit award separately.
